scope: E0 measurement validation only; status is finalized in verdict.json

cpu_moe.meaning: load-time CPU buffer override for routed expert tensors matching \.ffn_(up|down|gate|gate_up)_(ch|)exps; does not match shared experts or attention
cpu_moe.execution_guarantee: placement alone is not proof of scheduler execution

n_cpu_moe.meaning: same routed-expert override in layers 0 through N-1; N is layer count, not expert count

override_tensor.meaning: regex tensor name -> backend buffer type at load time; not cache, eviction, or quota management

load_mode.meaning: mmap maps GGUF; device uploads and CPU/backend repack may allocate additional buffers

warmup.meaning: BOS/EOS warmup then clear KV/reset performance; not the 128-token request

prefix_cache.meaning: n_past=0 then seq_rm from zero; re-prefill every request; weight buffers retained

CPU.reference: ggml_backend_cpu_set_use_ref(true), original Q4_0 weights, four threads on Android

OpenCL.MUL_MAT_ID_Q4_0: supported; contiguous Q4_0 weights and F32 activations
OpenCL.NX: Hexagon-style MUL_MAT_ID_NX is not implemented here; separate epilogue/combine fusions exist

HTP.multi_pd: unsupported by this local v73 registration policy; no multi-PD experiment performed
HTP.NX: enabled by default; runtime fusion logged
HTP.kernel_policy: MM_SELECT=3 HMX -> tiled HVX -> flat HVX -> scheduler fallback; FA_SELECT=2 HMX -> HVX -> fallback
HTP.numeric_n128: FAIL (HMX); retain fixed precision and routes

accounting.cgroup: v1 memory and cgroup2 mounts audited read-only; no new cgroup and no limit writes
accounting.peak_scope: existing inherited cgroup historical peak; may include other processes and previous workloads
accounting.pss: sampled maximum, not continuous true peak; synchronous first trial invalid due overhead; async boundary delay retained
accounting.driver: OpenCL advertised capacities separate from allocations; DMA-BUF fdinfo and available sysfs audited
accounting.pd: FastRPC session mapping logs; allocator ownership/physical residency not fully observable
accounting.ion_control: not established; no claim ION/rpcmem is constrained by cgroup

measurement.ttft: CLOCK_MONOTONIC full /completion POST callback entry to first synchronized sampled token ready
measurement.itl: adjacent server token-ready timestamps, linear-interpolated empirical p95 of 31 intervals
measurement.faults: process /proc/PID/stat original fields 10/12 after final comm parenthesis, bracketed by RUSAGE_SELF; exact request-boundary deltas
measurement.read_bytes: separate /proc/PID/io read_bytes request delta; not fault count times page size and not claimed physical UFS traffic
measurement.profiling: separate scheduler verbosity / HTP profile run; llama_synchronize before completed batch timestamp
measurement.unknown_encoding: JSON null or raw -1 means NA
